TextView.android:text: Balanced: 48MiB, 2 cores, GOGC=50, Warn log, Auto QUIC block, Prefer IPv4, 10s timeout.
Soft RAM cap for libsing-box.so; lower saves memory, higher prevents GC pauses.
Limits Go scheduler threads; 1-2 saves battery, 4+ boosts peak throughput.
Controls garbage collection aggressiveness; 25 trims RAM early, 100 reduces CPU.
DoH prevents DNS leaks over TLS; plain UDP is lighter and faster on weak links.
Resolves your proxy server domain and direct-bypassed domains locally.
IPv4 Only avoids broken IPv6 routes on mobile carriers; Prefer IPv4 keeps dual-stack.
Detects TLS/HTTP/QUIC headers for accurate domain routing and QUIC blocking.
Forces browsers onto reliable TCP; avoids UDP stalls on TCP-only proxies.
Routes local 192.168.x.x / 10.x.x.x traffic directly so LAN devices still work.
Sends Iranian .ir websites directly outside the proxy for lower latency.
5s fails fast on dead nodes; 10-15s tolerates high-latency mobile handshakes.
Reduces handshake latency by 1 RTT; turn OFF if your carrier drops TFO packets.
Error saves battery & I/O; Warn is balanced; Info helps debug routing issues.
